# Contributing

Thank you for helping improve the Songs of Syx Modding Handbook. Contributions are made through **issues**: the maintainer writes and checks every change to the pages, so please don't open pull requests.

## Reporting a mistake

New modders trust what the handbook tells them, so a wrong statement is the most useful thing you can report. [Open a mistake report](https://github.com/Bendigeidfran/Syx-Modding-Handbook/issues/new/choose) and include:

- the page, and the tag or section that's wrong;
- what the handbook says, and what actually happens;
- your evidence: the vanilla file in `base/data.zip`, a mod that shows the behaviour, or what you saw in game;
- the game version you're playing.

The handbook is written for the version named on its welcome page. If you're on a newer version, say so: the game may have changed.

## Suggesting a topic

If something you needed isn't covered, or a page was hard to follow, [open a suggestion](https://github.com/Bendigeidfran/Syx-Modding-Handbook/issues/new/choose). Say what you were trying to do and where you got stuck.

## How reports are handled

Every change is checked against the game's own files before it goes into the handbook. A report that can't be confirmed there may stay open while it's looked into, or be closed with an explanation.

## Code of conduct

Everyone taking part is expected to follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
